iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 73. CRITICAL: Islamabad talks COLLAPSED - US demands 20-yr enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. BREAKING: Pakistan officials say Iran WILLING to send delegation for 2nd round in Islamabad this week. IAEA locked out 8+ months. CNN: US/Israel targeting nuclear scientists. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. AP: China weighing custody of Iran uranium stockpile. Iran rejects Trump claim on surrendering nuclear material. IAEA DG Grossi urges strict verification. Probability 38%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 73. CRITICAL: Hormuz RE-CLOSED Apr 18 - IRGC fired on 3+ commercial vessels. Iran says will restrict ships until US blockade ended. Trump: 'may not extend ceasefire.' Ceasefire expires Apr 22 - NOW 2 DAYS. BREAKING: Pakistan says Iran WILLING to attend 2nd round talks. Xi calls for Hormuz to stay open. China expresses concern over US ship seizure. US seized Iranian ship Apr 19. Iran death toll 3,375+. Oil prices volatile. Probability 50%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 73. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Hezbollah claims attack destroyed Israeli tanks - NOT part of deal, remains armed. Israel holding 10km buffer zone inside Lebanon. Lebanon president says country will negotiate on own. Trump invites leaders to White House. Bloomberg: clashes dent truce hopes. In-principle extension agreement reported. Probability 18%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: NATO intercepted 3+ Iranian missiles over Turkish airspace. Patriot system deployed to Malatya. Roketsan opened Europe's largest warhead plant. TAYFUN Block-4 missiles delivered. NATO weighing expanding missile defenses at Turkish bases. Probability 5%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: Indian-flagged oil tanker crossed Strait of Hormuz over weekend. CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports severely. India and Pakistan offering escorts for ships through Hormuz. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 75. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting imminent. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Lavrov warns Russia's patience 'not unlimited.' Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 35%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US intelligence: China preparing MANPADS (shoulder-fired missiles) shipment to Iran - advanced radar, air defense systems. Taipei Times confirms. NYT: decades of Chinese weapons transfers documented. Xi calls for Hormuz to stay open, expresses concern over US ship seizure. NYT: Iran resistance offers uncomfortable lessons for China re Taiwan. ISW: PRC Taiwan infiltration documented. US redeploying from Pacific to Middle East benefits China. Probability 48%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 71. RISING: Launched 5 tactical ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 - 7th test of 2026. Kim 'great satisfaction' over new Hwasong-11 variant with high precision at 136km. Japan strongly protested. 3-day weapons test series Apr 6-8 including cluster-bomb warheads, ICBM engine test. Anti-ship/cruise missiles from Choe Hyon destroyer Apr 13. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Bloomberg: Kim ramps up tests as US reportedly curbs intel to Seoul. Probability 14%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1176+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles (24 ballistic from Iskander), 16+ killed, 118+ wounded. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - 40% export capacity disabled. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. IMF revised Russia 2026 growth UP (0.8% to 1.1%) on Iran war oil windfall. Lavrov: Russia's patience 'not unlimited.' Oil prices sliding after Hormuz brief reopening. Polymarket ceasefire by Apr 30: 0.4%. Probability 37%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: 'Open war' continues - Pakistan bombed major cities including Kabul. China-mediated Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Border clashes ongoing. Pakistani Taliban announced 3-day ceasefire for Eid. Pakistan operations against Taliban to continue despite peace talks. NPR confirms China brokering talks. Probability 5%. Stable.
